data.one_liner: Chip widget with event‑driven style and smooth animation
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable Chip that changes its appearance based on events. The style changes are animated for a polished look.
use_when: Need an animated, event‑driven chip for tags or selections
Want to customize chip appearance per state without writing boilerplate
avoid_when: You only need a static chip or a simple selectable widget
Your project already uses a different chip implementation that covers your use case
strengths: Easy to integrate into existing UI
weaknesses: No support for complex interactions beyond style changes
